styles.poster: Vertical advertising poster for the computer club ATON, one poster of a series sharing the same art direction: a deep navy night sky with stars, a dark pyramid in a desert at the bottom, a large glowing golden Eye of Horus (Egyptian pharaoh style) as the club's logo, gold and cyan neon lettering with a chrome bevel, a worn, creased 1990s-2000s paper print with torn edges. Every word on the poster is exactly the text given below, spelled exactly, in <<lang.script>> letters. Flat front view filling the frame.
styles.label: A flat rectangular label for a half-litre glass soda bottle, flat front view filling the frame, vintage Soviet-era printed paper label, an original illustration, no real brand logos. All words exactly as given, spelled exactly, in <<lang.script>> letters.
styles.icon: Inventory icon for a moody adventure game set in a computer club in 2004: the object centred and filling most of a square frame, softly lit from the upper left, painterly realistic style, plain dark warm-grey background with a faint vignette, no frame, no UI elements, no text except what is printed on the object itself.
styles.sign: A glowing green emergency exit sign, flat front view filling the frame, dark background. The word is exactly as given, in <<lang.script>> letters, with a running-man pictogram.
styles.newspaper: Front page of a regional <<lang.name>> newspaper from 2004, black and white print on slightly yellowed paper, masthead and columns of small <<lang.script>> text, two grainy photos, flat scan, no real newspaper names or logos.
